name: confluence
description: Work with Confluence Cloud pages, spaces, and search using the user's own site and API token. Load for page/space reads, CQL search, and creating pages.

content.inline:
## Confluence A multi-value connection: your **site** rides the base URL and your **Basic auth** rides a header. Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://{s/CONFLUENCE_SITE}.atlassian.net/wiki` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/CONFLUENCE_AUTH"}` (the stored value is `Basic `; create the token at id.atlassian.com -> Security). The venue substitutes `{s/CONFLUENCE_SITE}` and injects the header. Common calls: - Whoami: `GET /rest/api/user/current` - Spaces: `GET /rest/api/space?limit=50` - Pages: `GET /rest/api/content?type=page&limit=25` - One page (with body): `GET /rest/api/content/{id}?expand=body.storage,version` - Search (CQL): `GET /rest/api/content/search?cql=` (e.g. `text ~ "onboarding"`) - Create a page: `POST /rest/api/content` body `{"type":"page","title":"...","space":{"key":"KEY"},"body":{"storage":{"value":"

...

","representation":"storage"}}}` Rules: - Check `status`; errors are `{statusCode, message}`. 401 = bad token; 404 often means no access to that space. - URL-encode `cql` with `v/ops/jvm/url-encode`. Both the site and the auth header must be configured.
